translation.name: Nasoruan siGot len nasoruan ta Uluveu

book.name: Nauman gail
book.title: Nauman gail Nǝsa ahai pispisul gail lotogole

content: Nǝboŋ aPol tokǝta mǝtaltal van hǝn nǝSanhitrin ike, “Lalum̃an, aṽagw gail, len nǝmauran kavkav sagw len nǝhon aGot nǝlogw imasil vǝbar damǝŋai.”
Beti ab̃iltihai tutumav, aAnanias ikel mai alat lotoil tǝban aPol ke liṽos nabuŋon.
APol ipair van hǝni ike, “AGot tiṽas gaiug, gohum napisbile tob̃iŋb̃iŋal gotopiti topǝhapǝhw!
Gobǝtah ei, gusab̃ sǝhoti ke nǝsagol husur nalo siGot, avil gaiug gob̃ur kotov nalo nǝboŋ gotokel mai alatenan ke liṽos ginau.”
Alat lotoil tǝban luke, “Imabe gotosor tosa hǝn ab̃iltihai tutumav siGot?”
Ale aPol ike, “Aṽagw gail, nǝsalǝboii ke tovi b̃iltihai tutumav, husur len natosian siGot ike, ‘Sagisor tisa hǝn avan ideh toil a m̃o hǝn nǝvanuan sam̃ gail.’”

Nǝboŋ aPol tokǝta lǝboii ke galevis lovi Sattiusi, galevis am lovi Farisi, ikai van hǝn nǝSanhitrin ke, “Aṽagw gail, novi Farisi sua, notovi anatun siFarisi gail. Lukot hǝn ginau husur nǝ-vatvat-viri-an mai na-le-mǝhat-an dan nǝmatan!”
Nǝboŋ tokǝmaienan, naFarisi gail mai naSattiusi gail lotub̃at sor b̃alb̃al ale nab̃onb̃onan egǝm nǝtarhǝt eru.
(NaSattiusi gail luke sǝkad na-le-mǝhat-an dan nǝmatan, sǝkad aŋel ideh o nanunun ideh, be naFarisi gail lodǝlomi ke ikad galen p̃isi.)

Na-sor-b̃alb̃al-an iwal habat. Galevis lotovi hai p̃usan hǝn nalo siMoses lotovi Farisi am, lule mǝhat, lusor b̃al habat ke, “Namtsǝsab̃ natideh tosab len ategai. Hum ma nanunun ideh o aŋel ideh m̃au tosor maii.”
Nǝboŋ lotosor b̃alb̃al van, nakomada emǝtahw ke, dereh lisah pǝpas aPol, ale ikel mai nasoltia gail ke, levi pan, ale len nǝdaŋan salito lesǝhar kuvi dan nǝSanhitrin vi lan naim sisoltia gail.
Len mariug enan Nasub̃ eil tǝban aPol ike, “Gitah gat nǝlom̃! Gukel kot natit gail husur ginau len naut a Jerusalem, imagenan gimaskel koti len naut a Rom am.”
Na-sor-utaut-an hǝn nǝmatan siPol
Len nadudulan naJu gail lub̃onb̃on, luta gat na-kel-gati-an ke lukolkol hǝn nǝhanan mai namunan van vǝbar nǝboŋ lǝb̃igol aPol b̃imat.
Nǝvanuan lotob̃onb̃on len na-sor-utaut-an enan lusob̃ur sǝhor 40.
Luvan hǝn ab̃iltihai tutumav gail mai alat lotoil a m̃o seJu gail ale luke, “Namtukel gati ke sanamtihan ris natideh vir namtb̃igol aPol b̃imat.
Imaienan, gamito mai nǝSanhitrin, mitikel mai nakomada ke, tesǝhar aPol van hǝn gamito sum̃an ke mǝtb̃ike mǝtb̃isab̃ nakitinan am husuri. Namtoutaut hǝn namtb̃igole b̃imat a tahw hǝn b̃ibar gamito.”
Nǝboŋ ailoan ulum̃an matmat siPol tosǝsǝloŋ hǝn na-sor-utaut-an enan, evi lan naim sisoltia gail, eb̃is lan ale ikel uri mai aPol.
APol ekis nasenturion sua gǝmai ale ike, “Gesǝhar nǝmantuhmar egai van hǝn nakomada samito hǝn b̃ikel ur natsua mai atenan.”
Ŋa esǝhari van hǝn nakomada. Nasenturion ikel maii ke, “APol, dattotah gati len naim sidato, ekis ginau, ale eus ginau ke nesǝhar nǝmantuhmar egai gǝm hǝn gaiug. Ikad natsua hǝn b̃ikele mai gaiug.”
Nakomada etǝgau navǝlan ailoan aPol, elivi hǝn arb̃isor sǝb̃olaru. Eusi ke, “Guke gikel ur nǝsa mai ginau?”
Isor vari ke, “NaJu gail ludam̃ mai galit gabag ke, pelan dereh leus gaiug hǝn gǝb̃esǝhar aPol vi pan van hǝn nǝSanhitrin hǝn lǝb̃isab̃ nakitinan am husuri, be logǝgǝras.
Sagedǝlom galito. Lalum̃an lotosob̃ur sǝhor 40 losusuah, toh vir nagǝmaian siPol. Lukel gati ke salihan, salemun vǝbar lǝb̃igol aPol b̃imat. Gagai loutaut vir gaiug ke gǝb̃idam̃ hǝn nǝsa lotousi.”
Imagenan, nakomada enan ike nǝmantuhmar tivan, ale ikel maii ke, “Sagikel mai avan ideh ke gotokel ur nategai mai ginau.”
APol ivan hǝn aFeliks a Sisarea
Beti ekis nasenturion eru gǝmai, ike, “Mǝreutaut hǝn nasoltia lotovi 200, nasoltia nahos lotovi 70 mai nasoltia nǝsaran lotovi 200 hǝn lǝb̃evi Sisarea len namityal tomǝlapat damǝŋ len mariug.
Mǝreutaut hǝn nahos vir aPol, ale sǝhar aPol van hǝn aFeliks tovi gavna ei.”
Itos nalob̃ulat maiegai ke:
Ginau notovi Klautius Lisias nutos nategai van hǝn aGavna tovoi, aFeliks: Ivoi.
NaJu gail lutah gat ategai hǝn lǝb̃iṽabuni. Nǝboŋ notosab̃i ke tovi uleRom, ginau mai nasoltia gail namtuvan hǝni ale nulav kuvi dan galito.
Husur ke notoke nelǝboi nǝsaan lotoke togole, nosǝhari van hǝn nǝSanhitrin salito.
Nusab̃i ke lotokot hǝni husur na-sor-b̃alb̃al-an hǝn nalo salito, be nǝmatan o naim bǝbaŋis sanor hǝn nǝsa lotoke togole.
Nǝboŋ notosǝsǝloŋ hǝni ke tokad na-sor-utaut-an hǝn lǝb̃emǝdas ategai, vǝha-sua ŋai nosǝvati van hǝn gaiug. Nukel mai alat lotosor tas ategai ke likel mai gaiug nǝsaan lotonau ke togole. Sipa.
Imagenan nasoltia gail lugol husur nakelean sinakomada salito. Len mariug losǝhar aPol vi Antipatris.
Pelan han nasoltia gail lotoyar, lotǝlmam vi lan naim sisoltia gail, be nasoltia nahos gail luvan mai aPol sal.
Nǝboŋ lotobar naut a Sisarea lulav nalob̃ulat napisulan mai aFeliks tovi gavna ei, ale loriŋ aPol len navǝlan.
Nǝboŋ aFeliks toṽuruŋ nalob̃ulat, eus a Pol ke naut san matmat a be. Ale nǝboŋ tosǝsǝloŋ hǝni ke tovi uleSilisia,
ike, “Dereh nikot hǝn gaiug nǝboŋ alat lotosor tas gaiug lǝb̃ibar naut egai.” Beti ikel mai nasoltia galevis ke lekǝtkǝta kǝkol hǝn aPol len nab̃iltiim siHerot, gai toum hǝni tia sutuai.

footnotes.text: 23.3 Mat 23.27-28; Eze 13.10-11. Len naut egai aPol isor isa hǝn ab̃iltihai tutumav
23.35 Naim enan, aHerot toyalyal eum hǝni.
